answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake behind a crystal-clear identity record that bridges its past task history to its current key: before earning, it must complete small publicly checkable jobs whose results echo across independent verifiers. Faking one identity is cheap, but building credible history for thousands of sybils costs real compute, time, and locked stake slashed on fraud, so an attacker pays far more than honest agents while gaining no extra voting weight.
